info.name: ClearIt API
info.description:
Full ClearIt NestJS API — Customer Mobile, Agent Mobile, Admin Web.

**Swagger UI:** {{baseUrl}}/api
**OpenAPI JSON:** {{baseUrl}}/api-json

1. Run Admin → Auth → login (saves adminAccessToken).
2. For mobile: send-otp → verify-otp (OTP logged when OTP_DEMO_MODE=true).
3. Replace {{id}} / {{bookingId}} etc. with real UUIDs from list responses.
